learning.title: Review GitHub Actions workflow lockfiles before relying on movable action tags
learning.claim: GitHub announced on 14 October 2026 that Actions workflow dependency lockfiles are in public preview on Free, Team and Enterprise Cloud plans; a reviewed actions.lock can bind onboarded workflows to recorded action, transitive action and reusable workflow commit SHAs even when tags or branches move. Locking does not establish that a dependency is trustworthy.
learning.decision: ACTIONS_DEPENDENCY_LOCKFILE_REVIEW_GATE: REVIEW_ONLY. The current main tree has no .github/workflows/actions.lock. Inventory the actions/reusable-workflow dependencies, assess GitHub Actions lockfile preview eligibility, and use a non-mutating freshness check before any small pilot. Do not treat an untested preview as deployed protection or replace existing CI checks; require human review of pinned code and preserve working append-only workflows. Generate the lockfile with gh actions-lock (never hand-edit it); for reusable workflows, review the defining repository's lockfile because the caller's lockfile does not cover their internal transitive dependencies. The official how-to warns that gh actions-lock may rewrite workflow uses refs (including local ./ actions to $/), and SHA-pinned dependencies can invalidate tag-based action allowlists: inspect the complete generated diff and allowed-actions settings in a disposable PR before any rollout. The how-to currently labels availability Enterprise Cloud while the dated changelog lists Free/Team too; resolve this repository-specific discrepancy without enabling or bypassing policy.
learning.next_measurement: In an isolated review branch, inventory action uses refs and allowed-actions policy; verify repo-specific preview entitlement (changelog vs how-to discrepancy), review any gh actions-lock full diff, then run CI at exact HEAD. Record real system decision/report applied_learning_ids only after central promotion and consumer test; do not enable production protection on assumption.
fallback_history: If preview is unavailable or changes risk the append-only workflows, retain current checks and evaluate commit-SHA pinning manually in a separate safe PR.

sources.purpose: Clarify gh actions-lock generation, repository identity pinning, and reusable-workflow transitive dependency scope
sources.cost_quota: free official documentation; no API key
sources.reliability_limits: Public preview and subject to change. The caller repository's lockfile does not lock transitive dependencies inside a reusable workflow defined in another repository; that workflow is governed by its defining repository's lockfile. No rollout or enablement verified.
